connector.name: Prometheus MCP by mshegolev
connector.registryDescription: Prometheus MCP - query metrics, inspect alerts, and explore scrape targets (read-only).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package prometheus-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mshegolev account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PROMETHEUS_URL
env.description: Prometheus server URL, e.g. https://prometheus.example.com (no trailing slash)

env.name: PROMETHEUS_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token for authentication. Takes priority over Basic auth.

env.name: PROMETHEUS_USERNAME
env.description: HTTP Basic auth username. Used only when PROMETHEUS_TOKEN is not set.

env.name: PROMETHEUS_SSL_VERIFY
env.description: Verify SSL certificates (true/false). Set to 'false' for self-signed certs.
